meta.title: NiceChunk | Build the world. Verify the change.
meta.description: NiceChunk is a playable voxel civilization on Solana Devnet: deterministic terrain, verified mining, physical materials, forging, building, markets, skills, and Guardian relays.

hero.title: Build the world. Verify the change.
hero.subtitle: Explore a deterministic voxel world, mine measured resources, smelt and forge materials, build, trade exact items, and grow skills. Chunk.js renders each moment; Solana programs settle persistent state; Guardians relay nearby play.

world.title: Untouched terrain is generated. Player changes are recorded.
world.body: Seed and coordinates reconstruct every untouched block. When a player mines or builds, Solana programs validate the action and record the persistent delta. The browser can rebuild the same base world without downloading a hidden master map.

seed.title: Reconstruct, don't preload
seed.body: World seed plus coordinates produce terrain, water, vegetation, and resource candidates on demand.
seed.label: Seed

explore.title: Explore a Reconstructable World
explore.body: The browser generates terrain and biomes from public inputs, so the same seed and coordinates recover the same untouched world.

mine.title: Mine Verified Blocks
mine.body: A successful mining transaction updates the block, backpack, source counters, and skill records across one accepted chain action.

forge.title: Smelt, Shape & Forge
forge.body: Recipes consume exact inputs, produce materials by measured volume and yield, then turn those materials into verifiable geometry.

identity.title: Own Your Player Records
identity.body: Your wallet controls the player profile, backpack, and ten-skill ledger. Progress is more than a temporary browser save.

watchers.title: See Nearby Players Live
watchers.body: Guardians relay nearby presence, movement, and chat without taking custody of assets or replacing chain settlement.

economy.title: A material economy you can inspect.
economy.body: Resources carry measured volume, density, and mass from extraction through smelting and forging. Backpack custody, recipe inputs, forged geometry, and market listings stay explicit, so an item is more than a thumbnail or balance.

utility.genesis: Measured resource volume, density, and mass
utility.actions: Backpack custody and exact recipe inputs
utility.forging: Smelting output and player skill bonuses
utility.market: Forged geometry backed by material records
utility.governance: Exact-item escrow with atomic SOL or NCK settlement

watchers.title: Fast nearby play, without a second game authority.
watchers.body: Guardians discover regions and relay nearby presence, movement, chat, and short-lived hints. They never custody items or settle transactions; Solana remains the authority for persistent game state.

rules.title: Four layers. One explicit trust boundary.
rules.body: The browser renders immediate, reversible feedback. Guardians relay the live moment. Solana programs validate narrow actions and persist accepted state. Deterministic reconstruction rebuilds everything untouched from public inputs.

phase1.title: Live - Verifiable World
phase1.body: Chunk.js browser client, deterministic terrain, wallets, profiles, and chain-checked mining.

phase2.title: Live - Material Economy
phase2.body: Backpacks, measured resources, smelting, forging, and ten on-chain skill records.

phase3.title: Live Alpha - Marketplace & Building
phase3.body: Exact-item escrow, SOL/NCK settlement, blueprints, and persistent player construction.

phase4.title: Expanding - Guardian Regions
phase4.body: Regional discovery, nearby presence, movement, chat, and broader relay coverage.

phase5.title: Research - Useful Compute & Governance
phase5.body: NCM search, useful-compute proofs, and rule evolution remain open research, not hidden promises.

footer.tagline: A verifiable voxel civilization on Solana.
